$comment: Input-guardrail cases. Deterministic: no model call, so this tier is free
The `benign` half is the point. A filter that blocks everything scores a
perfect trigger rate, so trigger rate alone is not evidence of anything.
These are queries that LOOK adversarial — they contain the words 'ignore',
and the filter must let every one of them through. The false-positive rate
over this set is the number that says whether the guardrail is usable.
